NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    target_calories: "approx 1600-1750 kcal/day deficit on standard days; adjust -250..-400 kcal from maintenance; reassess biweekly"
    weekly_flex_meal_rule: "1 flex meal/week up to +600 kcal over daily target OR a single day at maintenance; not both"
  MACROS:
    protein: "1.6..2.0 g/kg/day; aim 30..40 g per meal and 20..35 g post-workout"
    carbs: "35..45% of kcal; emphasize low-GI, high-fiber; distribute around training"
    fats: "25..35% of kcal; prioritize mono/polyunsaturated; limit saturated/fried"
    fiber: "25..35 g/day"
  MEAL_TIMING:
    structure: "3 meals + 1..2 snacks; consistent timing"
    pre_workout: "for morning fasted cardio: water + electrolytes; if fasting glucose <90 mg/dL consume 10..15 g fast-acting carbs before starting"
    post_workout: "after resistance: 20..35 g protein + 25..40 g carbs within 2 h; after fasted cardio: breakfast within 60 min"
    flex_meal_timing: "schedule flex meal post-lift or most active day; avoid very late meals"
  FOOD_GUIDELINES:
    carbs_list: "oats, quinoa, brown rice, barley, whole-wheat pasta, lentils, beans, chickpeas, sweet potato, berries, apples, pears"
    protein_list: "chicken breast, turkey, lean beef, pork tenderloin, fish, salmon, tuna, eggs, greek yogurt, cottage cheese, tofu, tempeh, legumes, protein powder"
    fats_list: "olive oil, avocado, nuts, seeds, natural peanut butter, fatty fish"
    veg_list: "leafy greens, broccoli, cauliflower, peppers, zucchini, tomatoes, mushrooms, onions"
    avoid_limit: "sugary drinks, juices, refined sweets, large alcohol; limit high-GI refined carbs; minimize fried foods"
    sodium: "moderate; favor herbs/spices"
  DIABETES_CONSIDERATIONS:
    monitoring: "check glucose before fasted cardio and lifting; if <90 mg/dL take 10..15 g fast-acting carbs; if >250 mg/dL with ketones or >300 mg/dL postpone and contact clinician"
    during_exercise: "carry fast-acting carbs and water; metformin has low hypoglycemia risk but monitor symptoms"
    hydration: "200..400 ml water on waking; total 2..3 L/day; add electrolytes in heat"
    foot_care: "proper footwear; inspect feet daily"
  IF_OPTIONAL:
    approach: "time-restricted eating progression 12:12 to 14:10; advance to 16:8 only if well-tolerated with stable glucose"
    training_alignment: "keep fasted cardio low-intensity; prefer lifting within 2..4 h of first meal"
  POST-WORKOUT_SNACKS:

    option2: "protein shake 25..30 g + 1 small banana or 1/2 cup berries"
    option3: "cottage cheese 200 g + apple/pear + cinnamon"
    option4: "tuna pouch + 4..6 whole-grain crackers + carrot sticks"

    post_workout: "after resistance: 20..35 g protein + 25..40 g carbs within 2 h; after fasted cardio: breakfast within 60 min"
    flex_meal_timing: "schedule flex meal post-lift or most active day; avoid very late meals"

    carbs_list: "oats, quinoa, brown rice, barley, whole-wheat pasta, lentils, beans, chickpeas, sweet potato, berries, apples, pears"

    veg_list: "leafy greens, broccoli, cauliflower, peppers, zucchini, tomatoes, mushrooms, onions"

    sodium: "moderate; favor herbs/spices"

    foot_care: "proper footwear; inspect feet daily"
